title: Longest Streak
description: Write a function named longest_streak that finds the maximum number of consecutive identical elements in a list. If the list is empty, return 0.

hidden_tests.kind: streak occurring at the very end of list

hints: Streak counting requires maintaining two variables: the current streak length and the global maximum streak seen so far.
Inspect the transition when items[i] != items[i-1]: update max_streak = max(max_streak, current_streak) and reset current_streak to 1.
Remember to update max_streak one final time after exiting the loop in case the longest streak extends to the end of the list.
